text: Keep safe by not revealing personal information while using the internet. Personal information includes email id, address, photos, phone number, and password.
Don’t set up a meeting with those who you have only interacted with digitally. Meet online friends only in the presence of an adult family member.
Don’t agree to accepting information from unknown sources. Accept emails and messages only from people who you know.
All the information on the internet may not be correct. Understand what is reliable information and what is not with other resources: books, websites or someone who knows.
Decide to tell someone you know (teachers/adults/ family members) if you feel uncomfortable during digital interactions with others.
